items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align. AI-cost records also conflict: $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only the existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; create no new telemetry, spend, forecast, commitment, experiment, deployment, or monetization change.

Financial handoff: retain all SEO, UX, performance, content, accessibility, affiliate, and repository opportunities as deferred backlog only. Operating metrics such as impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, and AI usage are not financial returns without attributable revenue or documented cost savings. Preserve the existing reconciliation work and do not infer margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, or causal lift.
